fact: 1927年2月23日，柯立芝总统签署《1927年无线电法》（Radio Act of 1927，P.L. 69-632），设立联邦无线电委员会（Federal Radio Commission, FRC），取代商务部对广播的监管职能。FRC有权发放广播执照、分配频率与功率，要求电台服务于「公共利益、便利或需要」。此前1926年7月司法部长裁定商务部无权分配频率后，约250家新电台涌入频谱，广播陷入混乱。

sources.title: Library of Congress, Anniversary of the Radio Act of 1927, The Beginning of Broadcast Regulation
sources.quote: On Feb. 23, 1927, the act was signed into law, making radio regulation the responsibility of the independent Federal Radio Commission (FRC). The act gave the FRC the power to deny broadcasting licenses, and to assign frequencies and power levels for each licensee.

sources.title: National Archives Catalog, Federal Radio Commission (02/23/1927 - 06/19/1934)
sources.quote: To avoid a complete breakdown of the broadcasting industry, Congress enacted a law, approved February 23, 1927, authorizing the establishment of a new agency, the Federal Radio Commission, with power to issue radio station licenses, allocate frequency bands to all services.

fact: 1927年5月20日晨7时30分，25岁的查尔斯·林德伯格驾驶瑞安式NYP单翼飞机「圣路易斯精神」号从长岛罗斯福机场起飞，独自不间断飞越大西洋，历时33小时30分、航程约3614英里，于5月21日晚10时24分在巴黎布尔歇机场着陆，赢得奥泰格2.5万美元奖金。这是人类首次单人不着陆跨大西洋飞行。

sources.title: 央视网，林德伯格飞越大西洋
sources.quote: 1927年5月21日晚10点24分,"圣路易斯精神"号在不间断飞行了三十三小时三十分零三十秒,自纽约起飞三千六百一十四英里后,在巴黎着陆了。

sources.title: 深圳市盐田区政府，1927年5月21日 查尔斯-林白独自飞过大西洋
sources.quote: 1927年5月21日,将近10万巴黎人冲到布尔歇机场的柏油路面上为一个新的世界英雄的到来而欢呼。查尔斯-林白己安全着陆,完成了第一次独自一人从纽约到巴黎的直达飞行。

fact: 1927年8月23日午夜过后，意大利移民无政府主义者尼古拉·萨科与巴托洛梅奥·万泽蒂在马萨诸塞州查尔斯顿监狱被电刑处决。二人因1920年南布伦特里抢劫杀人案于1921年被判一级谋杀罪，审判中存在反意大利、反移民与反无政府主义偏见的指控。州长富勒8月3日拒绝赦免。处决后五天，波士顿街头送葬队伍达20万人。此案引发全球抗议。

sources.title: Mass.gov, Sacco & Vanzetti: The executions & funeral
sources.quote: Sacco and Vanzetti were electrocuted at Charlestown State Prison on August 23, 1927. ... Funeral procession for Sacco and Vanzetti, August 28, 1927, viewed from Tremont Street in Boston.

sources.title: Mass.gov, Reexamining Sacco and Vanzetti's Trial
sources.quote: They maintained their innocence for seven years before they were electrocuted on August 23, 1927. ... Five days after their execution, the funeral procession through the streets of Boston drew two hundred thousand mourners.

fact: 1927年5月起，福特汽车公司停产T型车，经过六个月的产线转换后，于12月2日推出A型车（Model A）。T型车自1908年投产至1927年停产共售出超过1500万辆。A型车起售价385美元，提供四种颜色，发布后两周内收到约40万份订单。A型车在密歇根州迪尔伯恩的鲁日工厂组装。

sources.title: Yahoo News UK, On This Day: Ford make first new car after ending Model T production
sources.quote: DECEMBER 2, 1927: Ford unveiled the Model A on this day in 1927 after stopping making the revolutionary Model T after 18 years of production. The town car, which sold for as little as $385, went on to become a huge success for the U.S. firm that pioneered mass production with its predecessor.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Automotive industry in the United States
sources.quote: Ford introduced the Model A in 1927, after a six-month production stoppage to convert from the Model T, and produced it to 1931. The Model A proved to be a quick success with 400,000 orders within two weeks.

fact: 1927年8月5日，纽约联邦储备银行将贴现率从4%降至3.5%，至9月13日全部12家联储银行完成降息。这次降息被联储理事会解释为帮助美国经济从1926年10月至1927年11月的温和衰退中复苏，以及缓解欧洲（尤其是英国金本位）的信贷紧张。1927年全年成员银行证券贷款增长15.8%，而商业贷款反而减少2.3亿美元。联储当年公开市场购入政府证券约8000万美元。

sources.title: Federal Reserve Bulletin, June 1989（联储历史回顾）
sources.quote: Under an inter-central-bank agreement in July 1927, the Federal Reserve relieved pressure on the pound by agreeing to lower interest rates... On August 5, the discount rate fell from 4 percent to 3.5 percent. Larger-than-seasonal open market purchases from the end of July to the end of December supplemented the discount policy.

sources.title: The Papers of Charles Hamlin, Preliminary Memorandum for the Open Market Investment Committee, October 18, 1927
sources.quote: all of the Federal Reserve Banks have since that meeting reduced their discount rates from 4 per cent to 3 1/2 per cent. The timing of these changes was as follows: July 29 - Kansas City, Aug. 4 - St. Louis, 5 - Boston, New York, 6 - Cleveland, 12 - Dallas, 13 - Atlanta, 16 - Richmond, Sept. 7 - Chicago, 8 - Philadelphia, 10 - San Francisco, 13 - Minneapolis.

fact: 据美国劳工部妇女局1929年公报引全国工业会议委员会（NICB）1927年调查，纽约市一个产业工人加妻子和两个孩子的四口之家维持「公平的美国生活标准」（不含储蓄）的最低年生活成本为1660美元（周均31.92美元），为12个调查工业城市中最高；俄亥俄州马里昂市最低为1442美元。1926年纽约五口之家的标准为1880美元。

sources.title: U.S. Department of Labor, Women's Bureau Bulletin No. 75, What the Wage-Earning Woman Contributes to Family Support
sources.quote: A recent study of the wage earner's cost of living is one made by the National Industrial Conference Board of the "average minimum cost of maintaining a fair American standard of living for the family of an industrial worker, his wife, and two children" in 12 industrial cities in 1927. These costs for the family of four, including no provision for savings, range from $1,442 a year in one of four small cities, Marion, Ohio, to $1,660 in New York City.

fact: 1927年纽约布鲁克林布朗斯维尔区工人公寓平均月租45美元（35至75美元不等），多为三间一套；该区工人家庭平均周薪38美元，但多数年收入超过55美元/周者并非全年受雇。房租约占收入30%。同期哈莱姆黑人区房租自1919年月均21—22美元翻倍至1927年的约40美元以上，黑人租户比同等面积白人住房平均多付7—10美元。

sources.title: The Daily Worker, Brooklyn Housing, 1927-02-24
sources.quote: The average rental is $45 per month, with rents varying between $35 and $75. ... In spite of the average wage, $38 a week! Wages vary considerably in Brownsville. Some families had an average wage-income of $20, others $80. ... rents average 30 per cent.

sources.title: 华东师范大学学报，从人口流变看纽约市哈莱姆贫民区的成因
sources.quote: 1919年,平均每个哈莱姆人房租为每月21或22美元,到1927年,租金就翻了一倍。有的街区,黑人租户平均租金为41.77美元。1927年,哈莱姆黑人住的三室套房比普通纽约人多付8美元房租,四室套房多付10美元,五室套房多付7美元。

fact: 1927年美国建筑行业工会小时工资率：纽约砖匠1.75美元、木匠1.50美元、油漆匠1.63美元、泥水匠1.75美元、水管工1.50美元；亚特兰大砖匠仅1.40美元。全行业工会小时工资率自1913年至1928年累计上涨161%，1922至1928年间上涨35%。1927年纽约产业工人四口之家的周均生活成本31.92美元意味着年收入需达到约1660美元才能维持基本生活。

sources.title: NBER, Volume II Labor（Building Trades Wage Rates, 1927）
sources.quote: Rates of wages in five important occupations, 1927: New York — Bricklayers $1.75, Carpenters $1.50, Painters $1.63, Plasterers $1.75, Plumbers and gas fitters $1.50. ... A compilation of the rates of wages in 1927 of five important occupations in various cities of the country shows that the high rate is sometimes nearly twice the low rate.

fact: 1927年适用的联邦资本利得税规则源自《1926年税收法》（沿用1921年法框架）：持有超过两年的资产出售利得可选择按12.5%的固定税率缴纳，替代累进所得税与附加税税率；持有两年以内的短期资本利得按普通所得税率课税。1921年法首次将资本资产单独定义并区分长短期。联邦所得税最高边际税率在1920年代中期已降至约25%（正常税+附加税），但资本利得优惠税率是独立通道。

sources.title: CRS Report 98-473, Individual Capital Gains Income: Legislative History
sources.quote: Revenue Act of 1921: For the first time, capital assets were specifically defined in the individual income tax code and were separated into long and short term assets. Assets held longer than two years were considered long-term... Net gains on long-term assets were, at the taxpayer's election, subject to a flat tax of 12.5% instead of taxes assessed at the regular and surtax rates.

sources.title: Internal Revenue Laws in Force April 1, 1927, Sec. 208 Capital Gains and Losses
sources.quote: The term "capital assets" means property held by the taxpayer for more than two years (whether or not connected with his trade or business), but does not include stock in trade of the taxpayer... The term "capital gain" means taxable gain from the sale or exchange of capital assets consummated after December 31, 1921.

fact: 1927年适用的《1924年移民法》（Johnson-Reed Act）设立国家来源配额制度，以1890年人口普查为基数分配各国移民配额，事实上禁止亚洲移民。1927年联邦无线电委员会开始颁发广播执照，要求申请者证明服务符合「公共利益、便利或需要」。联邦所得税申报制度已运行14年（自1913年第十六修正案），个人需就工资、利息、股息和资本利得申报纳税。

sources.title: Library of Congress, Anniversary of the Radio Act of 1927
sources.quote: The act gave the FRC the power to deny broadcasting licenses, and to assign frequencies and power levels for each licensee.

sources.title: Wikiwand, Federal Radio Commission
sources.quote: the FRC introduced the standard that, in order to receive a license, a radio station had to be shown to be "in the public interest, convenience, or necessity".

fact: 1927年纽约证券交易所全年成交567,990,875股，打破历史纪录（1928年进一步升至920,550,032股）。道琼斯工业指数从年内的低位稳步攀升，年末接近200点水平（1921年初约72点）。标准统计410股指数从年初105.5升至年末134.1。1927年「牛市真正开始发力」，但距1929年10月崩盘仅两年。

sources.title: Paul Johnson, A History of the American People（引文）
sources.quote: In 1927 the number of shares changing hands, at 567,990,875, broke all records. The figure then rose to 920,550,032. Two new and sinister elements emerged: a vast increase in margin-trading and a rash of hastily cobbled-together investment trusts.

sources.title: Brookings Institution, Credit Policies of the Federal Reserve System
sources.quote: The stock market showed no effect of the curtailment of business activity, advancing rather steadily throughout the year. The low for the year was practically as high as the high for all preceding time, and the general average at the end of the year was 75 per cent above that of the middle of 1924.

fact: 美国无线电公司（RCA）股票是1927年投机热潮的标志性标的。RCA自成立以来从未支付过股息。其股价1921年在场外市场低至约1.50—2美元，1927年3月已升至121美元附近，并在当月出现逼空行情（corner）——当日成交3,909,100股，为纽交所130年来最大单日成交量。到1929年4月，RCA经拆股调整后最高达570美元以上。保证金交易者只需10%保证金即可买入。

sources.title: TIME, Business & Finance: Stock Market（1927年3月报道）
sources.quote: Radio Corporation finally opened at $120½. A few minutes later it was at $138½... The day's total trading was 3,909,100 shares, the largest day in the 130 years of the history of the Stock Exchange.

sources.title: American Heritage, The Days of Boom and Bust
sources.quote: Radio Corporation of America went to 573¾ (adjusted) without ever having paid a dividend. Only the hopelessly eccentric, so it seemed, held securities for their income. What counted was the increase in capital values.

sources.title: John Cassidy, Dot.con（引文）
sources.quote: RCA's stock didn't recover its April 1929 level until 1964 — thirty-five years later. ... In 1921 it's stock hit a low of 1½. Thereafter, it climbed steadily until 1927, when it headed for the stratosphere.

fact: 投资信托（investment trust）行业在1927年初规模尚小：1927年1月1日全行业资本约7亿美元，1924年仅49家，到1927年3月增至179家。SEC后来的调查表明，该行业90%的增长发生在1927—1929这三年间，到1929年底膨胀至约70亿美元。1927年7月纽约州开始调查投资公司运作。多数投资信托通过经纪商贷款（brokers' loans）加杠杆，且多为封闭式结构，1929年后大量倒闭。

sources.title: SEC Senate Testimony, Investment Trusts and Investment Companies（1940）
sources.quote: On January 1, 1927, the industry was of negligible size. At that time it had received total contributions of capital in the neighborhood of $700,000,000. Ninety percent of the entire growth of the industry took place in the next 3 years.

sources.title: Brown Brothers Harriman, Origins of the Modern Mutual Fund
sources.quote: In 1924, there were just 49 such trusts; by March 1927 the number had jumped to 179. In 1928 and 1929, the market exploded, with more than a billion dollars flowing into investment trusts in the first eight months of 1929 alone.

sources.title: AIER, Investment Trusts and Funds From the Investor's Point of View
sources.quote: In July 1927 New York State began an investigation of the investment company movement. Questionnaires were sent to the officers of the various organizations in order to ascertain their policies and procedure.

fact: 1927年保证金交易（margin trading）迅速扩张。经纪人贷款（brokers' loans）在1920年代初约10亿美元，到1929年10月崩盘前膨胀至85亿美元。1927年成员银行证券贷款增长15.8%，而商业贷款减少。投机者只需10%保证金即可买入股票（即10倍杠杆）。联储1927年8月的降息被后世联储官员（如Miller）评价为「联储或任何银行体系犯过的最昂贵错误之一」，因为它释放的流动性大量流入证券市场。

sources.title: American Heritage, The Days of Boom and Bust
sources.quote: Margin accounts expanded enormously... During the summer, brokers' loans increased at the rate of $400,000,000 a month. By September they totaled more than $7,000,000,000. The rate of interest on these loans varied from 7 to 12 per cent and went as high as 15.

sources.title: The New York Times, Bank Rate and Speculation, 1931-01-28
sources.quote: Dr. MILLER of the Reserve Board expressed his own judgment last Friday that this policy was one of the "most costly errors ever made by the Federal Reserve or any other banking system."

sources.title: Stocks and News, Radio Part II
sources.quote: the level of margin debt (the amount that brokers lent out) in 1920 was about $1 billion. By the time of the Crash in October 1929, this figure was $8.5 billion.

fact: 1927年通用汽车（GM）超越福特成为美国最大汽车制造商。GM的年型更换策略（annual model changes）、按价格层级分设品牌（雪佛兰—奥克兰—别克—凯迪拉克）和GMAC消费信贷（1919年设立）构成新的商业模式。1927年克莱斯勒收购道奇，获得制造设施与经销商网络。同年福特鲁日工厂开始组装A型车，该工厂最终雇用10万人，实现从原材料到整车的垂直整合生产。底特律成为全美工资最高的城市。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Automotive industry in the United States
sources.quote: During the late 1920s, General Motors overtook Ford to become the largest automaker. Under the leadership of Alfred P. Sloan, General Motors instituted decentralized management and separate divisions for each price class. They introduced annual model changes. ... In 1927, he [Walter Chrysler] acquired Dodge.

sources.title: The Henry Ford, Henry Ford: Case Study of an Innovator
sources.quote: The River Rouge complex became a symbol of Ford's ambition and scale, a testament to his vision for vertically integrated production. Eventually the plant would employ 100,000 people and generate many innovations in auto manufacturing.

fact: 1927年美国商业广播进入快速扩张期。全国广播公司（NBC）于1926年成立，RCA既制造收音机又提供节目内容，形成垂直整合的广播帝国。1927年《无线电法》设立FRC后，732家广播电台被重新分配到89个频道。广播收音机成为大众消费品，百货商店因收音机热销而客流大增。RCA、GE、西屋电气通过交叉持股控制广播产业链。

sources.title: NIST ITS, February 1927: Federal Radio Commission Established
sources.quote: The Federal Radio Commission listened to conflicting claims to frequencies and weighed public opinion; they became known for withholding radio licenses from broadcasters in their zeal to "bring order out of chaos, by placing the 732 broadcasting stations on 89 wavelengths, so as not to create interference."

sources.title: RadioInfo Asia, A century-old warning from radio: Is AI listening?
sources.quote: RCA, then the leading media and technology stock... In 1921, RCA made broadcasting history by delivering the world's first live radio coverage of a heavyweight championship boxing match... the next day, department stores were crowded with customers lining up to buy radios.
